review.note: Replaced 2026-08-27: the previous asset's licence was unconfirmed (likely CC BY-NC-SA community source), which blocked commercial reuse. Regenerated as an original procedural texture — no external asset, no third-party licence, no attribution needed. Parameters follow Marsset et al. 2020 (VLT/SPHERE): Pallas is 'the most cratered object known in the asteroid belt' (a 'golf ball' texture) with two distinct large impact basins, so it gets the densest cratering plus two oversized basins of the six generated bodies.
